query:
SELECT COUNT(*) as count
        FROM deals
        WHERE ($1::text IS NULL OR deal_status = $1)
          AND ($2::uuid IS NULL OR originator_id = $2)
          AND ($3::uuid IS NULL OR investor_id = $3)
          AND ($4::uuid IS NULL OR borrower_id = $4)
          AND ($5::text IS NULL OR industry = $5)
